name: My Clock
summary:
My Clock is a clock that functions as a non-immersive 2D display within the system: it shows the time in either digital or analog format, depending on your preference.

My Clock is a desktop clock that runs as a non-immersive 2D panel integrated into the viewer's operating system. It offers two display modes: a digital clock with clear, large numbers, and a classic analog clock with hour, minute, and second hands that rotate on precise pivots.
